draft.heroMessage: Building relationships, not just transactions, in Portland real estate.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I'm Gavin Shettler, your Portland real estate broker. Whether you're looking to buy, sell, or invest, I’m here to provide clear guidance, honest advice, and deep knowledge of our neighborhoods.
draft.tagline: Honesty, Integrity, Expertise—Portland's Trusted Real Estate Partner.
draft.aboutParagraph: Real estate is about more than the home itself—it's about the community, energy, and people that turn it into something special. My approach is rooted in honesty, direct communication, and empowering you with knowledge. I'm a certified Earth Advantage Broker, an Energy Trust Ally, and also an ADU specialist, so I can help you navigate high-efficiency homes and opportunities for additional living spaces. My focus is to serve as a facilitator, negotiator, and genuine advocate at every stage of your real estate journey in Portland and the surrounding areas.
draft.conciergeLine: Looking for expertise on high-efficiency homes, green technology, or adding an ADU? Let’s talk through your options—call me today.
draft.contactLine: Ready to connect? Reach out directly at (509) 219-9672. I’m here to help with your next move.
draft.tone: Approachable, knowledgeable, and community-focused, with an emphasis on honesty and lasting relationships.

sections.title: The best homes deserve the best agents
sections.body: Redfin Premier agents are local luxury experts with years of experience buying and selling high-end homes. Only our best agents qualify to become Redfin Premier agents. When you're ready to buy, your agent will know what it takes to write a winning offer for the most highly sought-after homes. And when it's time to sell, they will know how to price, prepare, and market your home, so it attracts qualified buyers and sells for top dollar.

sections.title: Meet Gavin's Team
sections.body: When you work with Redfin, one agent is responsible for your success, but you really get a whole team. Redfin agents work closely with a team of real estate professionals to ensure every sale closes without a hitch.
